title: Introduce token-journey tracelets and alert deadband to reduce long-tail noise
author: Priya Nambiar
release_notes: Adds compact token-journey tracelets for long-tail signal capture and introduces alert deadband configuration to reduce churn from transient token-cost spikes.
description: Context and motivation: Long-tail token-cost/latency spikes generate a disproportionate number of alerts and require manual triage even when root causes are transient (prefix churn, ephemeral kernel contention, or client-side retries). This PR introduces a compact per-invocation 'tracelet' representation that captures token-journey fingerprints (phase timings, cache hit markers, kernel wait durations) and a configurable alert deadband that suppresses alerts for short-lived deviations below a configurable duration threshold. Design summary: 1) Tracelets: a condensed span format emitted from the runtime when invocation tokens exceed a shape threshold. Tracelets serialize: invocation_id, token_shape_hash, phase_durations (tokenize/attn/kv/read/emit), kv_cache_hits boolean array summary, and a micro-timestamp sketch for burstiness. The format is intentionally compact (~120-250B) and ingested by the observability pipeline as a high-cardinality but low-volume stream. 2) Alert deadband: per-alert policy parameter (deadband_ms) that requires a condition to persist for N ms before firing; supports exponential backoff and per-tenant overrides. 3) Dashboard and query additions: new 'Token Journey' panel (small multiples of tracelet aggregates) and an 'Alert Deadband' policy control surface in the SLO/Alerts settings. Checklist: - [x] Runtime: emit tracelet when token count > 128 or kv-miss rate > 0.2 - [x] Ingest: add tracelet parser and compact index in telemetry pipeline - [x] Query: add aggregation helpers in metrics DSL for median phase durations and burst sketch - [x] UI: new dashboard panels and alert policy UI control - [x] Tests: unit tests for serializer, e2e ingestion smoke, and alert deadband unit tests - [x] Docs: observability doc update and runbook note Commits (summary): - 0a1f3b1: introduce tracelet protobuf and runtime serializer - 9b2c4e0: runtime hook to emit tracelets on finish - fc7d9a4: telemetry parser, compact indexing and storage adapter - d4a0bde: metrics DSL aggregation helpers and example queries - e6b1c99: alert deadband engine + API and per-tenant override - b3a2f77: dashboard panels and UI wiring - f8c3d21: tests and docs Changes (high level): - runtime/service/tracelet_serializer.go: add Tracelet proto, serializer and emission hook - runtime/sampler/config.go: add thresholds for tracelet emission - telemetry/parsers/tracelet_parser.py: parse compact tracelets and extract phase histograms - telemetry/index/compact_indexer.go: store tight token-shape buckets for fast rollups - observability/dashboards/token_journey_panels.json: new dashboard definition - ui/alerts/deadband_policy.py + migrations: add deadband fields to alert policy model - docs/observability/tracelets.md: design and runbook examples Review conversation summary: - Ethan Brooks requested tightening the tracelet emission threshold to protect low-volume tenants; we added a tenant-rate cap and ability to opt-out via tenant flags. - Marco Li suggested adding kv-cache hit bitmap compaction to reduce index cardinality; updated parser to store a 4-bit summary instead of full bitmap. - Sofia validated the alert deadband semantics against SLO use-cases and asked for an explicit backoff loop for sustained regressions; implemented exponential backoff (2x up to 1 minute) and added docs. - Small follow-ups addressed by author: removed a noisy debug log, added additional unit tests around serialization edge-cases, and made the UI toggles accessible via keyboard. CI summary: - Build: pass - Unit tests: pass (tracelet serializer, parser, alert deadband tests) - E2E smoke: pass (ingest + dashboard render on staging) - Lint: pass - Flaky: one prior flaky test (telemetry replay) re-run and passed Merge outcome: PR was squashed on merge to main after approvals from Ethan and Marco; merge deploys telemetry migration and dashboard to staging then to prod during the next planned rollout. Observability impact and rollout plan: - Start: feature gated off by default. - Stage: enable for internal tenants only, run for 48 hours to validate cardinality and storage cost. - Ramp: enable deadband defaults (250ms) for all hosted tenants after telemetry confirms <0.5% increase in metric ingestion size. - Mitigations: tenant opt-out flag, storage TTL fallback (7d), and auto-disable if ingestion growth > 5% in 24h. Backwards compatibility and data model notes: - Tracelets are append-only supplemental telemetry; no breaking change to existing spans. - Alert deadband adds fields to alert policy model with defaults; migration uses non-destructive defaults. Related work and references: - ENG-8421 (Linear): long-tail alert noise reduction - design doc: /docs/observability/tracelets-design.md - runbook addition: docs/observability/runbooks/tracelet-investigation.md
notes: Deployed to staging 2026-02-25 behind feature flag. Observability team to monitor ingest cardinality for 72 hours before wider rollout.
hotfix_followup: None required. If early cardinality growth observed, revert via tenant-flag and short-circuit tracelet emission in runtime.
testing_summary: Unit: serializer/edge-cases, parser aggregation helpers. Integration: staging ingest + dashboard render. Load test: simulated 10k invocations/min with 5% high-shape traffic to validate index sizing.
